theorems.statement: ∀ (R : Type*) [CommRing R] (m : ℕ) (D : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) R) (r c : Fin (m + 1)), (∀ i j, D r c ∣ D i j) → ∃ (P Q : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) R) (C : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) R), IsUnit P ∧ IsUnit Q ∧ P * D * Q = Matrix.of (fun i j => Fin.cases (Fin.cases (D r c) (fun _ => 0) j) (fun i' => Fin.cases 0 (fun j' => C i' j') j) i)
